title: Prior VIX Relative Volatility Regime Context
question: Does the most recent strictly prior Cboe VIX daily close, expressed as a causal position within its own trailing 252-session distribution, create a broad LOW or HIGH external-volatility context that materially separates the frozen six-strategy portfolio's 2x-cost stressed R and stop-loss incidence after controlling for strategy and period?
hypothesis: A strategy-period-centered external volatility regime may distinguish opportunity quality across the whole portfolio without tuning an absolute VIX level. A LOW or HIGH trailing-distribution edge is informative only if return and stop effects are economically coherent and repeat across periods and strategies.
why_now: Unit 044 closed Program 5 invalid with no sizing seed. A distinct Program 4 proposal then reconstructed every one of 2,233 lifecycles outcome-free and found zero later native nonzero signals while positions were held, so it was rejected without an allocated unit and without an adjacent age, mark or exit rescue. Whole-map comparison now favors a broad Program 2 external-volatility state that is structurally distinct from Unit 041's scheduled-release windows and can use an official immutable daily source plus the dense tracked portfolio evidence.

macro_rotation.program_4_rejection_reason: All 2,233 lifecycles had no later nonzero SIGNAL_DECIDED event while the same component position remained open; there is no reconfirm-versus-contradict bundle to allocate.
macro_rotation.program_1: A broad same-day prior-signal proposal was just rejected before Unit 044 and is not rescued with a narrower signal context.
macro_rotation.program_2: Selected for a different macro object from Unit 041: a causal prior-close relative volatility regime rather than scheduled event timing.
macro_rotation.program_3: Unit 042 recently closed; no adjacent clock or session variant.
macro_rotation.program_4: The new held-position signal proposal was structurally zero; no adjacent mark, age, exit or RC4-only rescue.
macro_rotation.program_5: Unit 044 just closed; no lot, deposit, slot or risk-geometry successor.
macro_rotation.program_7: Unit 043 recently closed; evidence-lane diagnosis cannot monopolize topic selection.
macro_rotation.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not open another VIX level, rolling window, percentile cut, volatility index, event or external-market successor automatically.

variants.definition: The prior close empirical percentile is at most one third.
The prior close empirical percentile is at least two thirds.

context_anchor.definition: The prior close empirical percentile is strictly above one third and strictly below two thirds. It is reported but cannot independently select a successor.

official_external_source.meaning: Cboe's market estimate of expected volatility derived from SPX option prices.
official_external_source.unconsumed_ohlc_note: A preliminary non-contract check found 47 OHLC consistency anomalies from 1992-02-11 through 2006-02-08 and none from 2021 onward. OPEN/HIGH/LOW are not used for classification, metrics, gates or verdict; the exact file hash remains pinned.
official_external_source.source_limit: Cboe states that the historical data is furnished for visitor convenience without an accuracy guarantee. This unit treats the exact downloaded snapshot as its finite external context input.

immutable_portfolio_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

fixed_regime_classification.birth_date: UTC calendar date of OPEN or PASSIVE_FILL.
fixed_regime_classification.prior_close: The latest Cboe VIX DATE strictly earlier than the birth UTC date. Same-date VIX is never used even if the portfolio birth occurs after the US close.
fixed_regime_classification.window: Exactly 252 available VIX daily CLOSE observations ending at and including the selected prior close.
fixed_regime_classification.percentile: Count of the 252 window closes less than or equal to the selected prior close divided by 252.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only event identity, OPEN/PASSIVE_FILL UTC birth dates, strategy, period, Cboe DATE/CLOSE and derived regime were accessed. No close value, stressed R, planned risk, stop association, conditional economic metric or Unit 045 verdict was accessed.

predeclaration_execution_disclosure.discarded_derived_display: The first successful classification displayed each regime's number of grouped cells, 24, as the minimum cell count. The classification and all pooled/period/strategy counts were correct; only that derived display was discarded and recomputed as 2/2/6 without opening economic outcomes.

fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a persisted-state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed close-before-birth precedence, then source path and line.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned_risk from detail.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE supplies direction and positive planned_risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins one Passive lifecycle.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle. value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.stressed_r: value_b at close divided by the positive planned risk frozen at birth or placement.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.stop: EXTERNAL_CLOSE is one stop-loss exit; CLOSE is not.
fixed_lifecycle_reconstruction.regime_attachment: Attach exactly one regime from the birth UTC date before any close metric is used.

fixed_centered_metrics.cell: One strategy-period combination across all regimes.
fixed_centered_metrics.cell_mean_stressed_r: Mean stressed R of every lifecycle in the cell.
fixed_centered_metrics.cell_stop_rate: Stop-loss fraction of every lifecycle in the cell.
fixed_centered_metrics.lifecycle_centered_r: Lifecycle stressed R minus its cell mean stressed R.
fixed_centered_metrics.lifecycle_centered_stop: Lifecycle stop indicator minus its cell stop rate.
fixed_centered_metrics.variant_pooled_residual_r: Mean lifecycle-centered R across the variant.
fixed_centered_metrics.variant_pooled_stop_residual: Mean lifecycle-centered stop across the variant.
fixed_centered_metrics.period_residuals: The same centered means within each of P1-P4.
fixed_centered_metrics.strategy_residuals: The same centered means within each of the six strategies.
fixed_centered_metrics.contribution_share: For periods and strategies separately, absolute centered-R numerator for one member divided by the sum of absolute member centered-R numerators.

fixed_integrity_gate: The Cboe source retains 471,901 bytes and SHA-256 9E6A6958041079E56848337439BE5B250B2FE97131751FCD7CF4750A7D31720E, with 9,258 unique strictly increasing DATE rows and finite positive CLOSE values.
All six portfolio files retain their listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.

Reconstruct exactly 16,477 portfolio data rows, 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals 272/206/805/118/238/594, 407.0477 USD stressed net and 206 stop-loss exits with zero lifecycle, pending, risk, close or regime fault.
Classify exactly LOW/MIDDLE/HIGH 924/610/699 with the frozen period and strategy counts and all 72 strategy-period-regime cells present.
Every lifecycle receives exactly one strictly prior close and a complete 252-close window; same-date or future VIX observations are never attached.

density_requirements: At least 80 lifecycles in each of P1-P4.
At least 30 pooled lifecycles in each of the six strategies.
information_requirements: Absolute pooled centered stressed-R residual is at least 0.10R.
Absolute pooled centered stop residual is at least 0.05.
Pooled return and stop residuals are economically coherent: their signs are nonzero and opposite.
At least three of four period centered-R residuals share the pooled R sign.
At least three of four period centered-stop residuals share the pooled stop sign.
At least four of six strategy centered-R residuals share the pooled R sign.
At least four of six strategy centered-stop residuals share the pooled stop sign.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one strategy contributes more than 55% of the variant's absolute centered-R numerator.
fixed_variant_gate.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes.
fixed_variant_gate.selection_if_both_pass: Select at most one later question by larger absolute pooled centered-R residual, then larger absolute pooled centered-stop residual, then lexicographic variant id.
fixed_variant_gate.failure_action: Do not rescue with an absolute VIX level, another trailing window, quartile/quintile, trend, rate of change, realized volatility, another volatility index, strategy subset, direction, period, event or session.

requirements: Both edge variants complete their frozen reports.
At least one edge variant passes its full gate.
fixed_bundle_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later independently named portfolio-wide, entry-preserving VIX-context response question. Unit 045 selects no filter, lot, slot, exit, threshold, EA or Live behavior, and the later question cannot open automatically.
fixed_bundle_gate.failure_action: Close with no external-volatility seed and return to whole-map comparison.

verdict_rules.success: PASS_ONE_PRIOR_VIX_RELATIVE_REGIME_CONTEXT_QUESTION when integrity passes and at least one edge variant passes every frozen gate.
verdict_rules.failure: NO_PRIOR_VIX_RELATIVE_REGIME_CONTEXT_PASSED when integrity passes and neither edge variant passes every frozen gate.
verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_VIX_SOURCE_OR_LIFECYCLE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_CONTEXT_VERDICT when any source, input, lifecycle, regime or anchor integrity check fails.
verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_NO_VIX_CONTEXT_SEED only if integrity passes but an unforeseen semantic condition prevents exact application without changing the frozen contract.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration plus the exact Cboe snapshot before reading any Unit 045 close value, stressed R, stop association, residual, gate or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the seven immutable inputs.
Do not change the 252-session window, percentile formula, tercile cuts, prior-date rule, centered baseline, variants, metrics or gates.
Do not modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, retain an analysis CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close the family after one result and recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 without an adjacent VIX or Program 2 successor.
